{{Quote|The disease is exceptional&mdash;it spent a millennia locked away, and when the Empire blew open its vault, it came out even deadlier. It attacks the central nervous system. Seizures and agonizing death follow in hours.|[[Brenna Fash]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''virus''' was locked away in one of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vaults on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that attacked the central nervous systems of its victims, causing seizures and then [[Death/Legends|death]] within hours. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] unintentionally released it by breaching the containment vault, and it began to spread throughout the [[High Security Section]]. [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] were immune to the virus, but it incubated in their tissue, turning them into carriers.
